finding: Obesity was associated with several intrapartum complications, including cesarean section (30%), instrumental delivery (15%), gestational diabetes, meconium stained liquor, macrosomic babies, pregnancy induced hypertension, reduced rate of vaginal birth after cesarean section, failure to progress of labour, stillbirth, and preeclampsia.
